snippet_primary: "For the last two or three years, my course, which took months to develop, has been sold for less than a euro (0.99€), and people get the course without really knowing clearly that they pay a yearly subscription. Domestika is winning two times because they're charging users a high subscription fee (say 200€) after paying 0.99€, and we receive 25% of 0.99€. So that's a really nasty move. Now, they're not even paying my royalties since the last five months."
